answer: Buying 6 genuinely separate vantage points per alias is the copycat's cost, and each one has to keep a echo record clean through the lantern check. An attestation only counts if the attester's network origin differs from the attested identity's in at least the first two octets, and 6 such diverse attestations are required. Clones sharing one datacenter or one proxy pool produce an island signature that collapses to a single origin, which means the cluster is discounted at settlement. That is 9 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
